scope:
Root-run owned solo: real F3 nut event, normal cutting, E one hand piece, Q boss shot.

Inert on import. Reuses FirstRelaxSolo's owned-editor/standalone PIE lifecycle,
actual game-window capture and settings/map restoration. Never adopts an existing
PIE. Root must review CaptureReady.json's early PNG and write CaptureApproved.json
with {"approved": true} in that run directory. No saves, network, HP/counter edits,
HitFood/Collect/ThrowOne/ReceiveToolDamage calls, or clock jumps.

Disclosed PIE fixtures: F3 NutEncounter skips normal progression; the naturally
arrived knight's actor tick is briefly paused; player/one real nut/one native cut
piece receive supported placement; whole-nut/player placement is refreshed once
after root's review wait with native physics continuing; a real camera targets the shot.
The selected native cut fragment is temporarily kinematic during pickup setup;
native E owns its hand state and native Q must restore physical flight.
All Two/LMB/E/Q events use actual mapped Enhanced Input actions via vector injection.
The original boss tick and view target are restored before the owned PIE ends.

cleanup.static_fragment_fixture: Owned PIE teardown; native E/Q owns later hand/physics state

limits: One disclosed local fixture and one shot; no complete fight, hardware keyboard, network or cold packaged launch claim.
fixture_changes: Supported player/nut/fragment placement only; no HP or expected-state writes
Refresh supported whole-nut/player placement once at gate approval; zero velocities, native physics continues
Selected native cut fragment is kinematic only for initial E pickup setup; collisions unchanged; native Q must reenable physics
Pause the naturally arrived knight actor tick during this focused shot
Temporary live PIE CameraActor view target

sequence_capture_policy.timing: Actual capture request/completion wall times and native game times; no fixed-step override

external_capture: Independent HWND Windows Graphics Capture; periodic SWindow sequence disabled; named evidence PNGs retained

static_fragment_fixture.scope: Disclosed initial static fragment fixture; no natural loose-fragment physics claim. E/Q and collision gates unchanged.
